common_conditions: TS23.280 V19.9.0 Stage2 SIP-core functional model
condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

conditions: Registrar finder used in the deployment
claims.conclusion: Finder identifies serving registrar using the relevant provider's SIP database, optionally operator topology/availability. A single-registrar deployment need not use a finder.
Registrar maintains user identity/location association and registration-state notifications, and can select application services.
Functional entity descriptions do not imply separate physical entities.

limitations: Does not specify worker affinity, dialog routing, Call-ID hashing, failover or registration-state replication.
TS23.228, TS23.002 and SIP protocol dependencies are not independently checked.
V19.9.0 only; later-version equivalence not asserted.
